f.title: Report postmarketing ICSRs via ESG NextGen in E2B(R3) from October 1, 2026
f.statement: Starting October 1, 2026, postmarketing ICSRs for human drug products, biological products, and drug- or biologic-led combination products submitted via the Electronic Submissions Gateway Next Generation (ESG NextGen) must be reported using the E2B(R3) data standards (91 FR 17284). This extends the previously recommended E2B(R3) implementation period by six months.
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Postmarketing ICSRs for human drug products, biological products, and drug- or biologic-led combination products submitted via ESG NextGen. The Timelines section restates this: 'Beginning October 1, 2026, all ICSRs submitted via the ESG NextGen must be submitted to the AEMS database using E2B(R3) data standards.'
f.exceptions: The page states elsewhere that submitters using the Safety Reporting Portal (SRP) need take no action.

rows.actor: Companies with postmarketing reporting requirements submitting via ESG NextGen
rows.quote: On April 6, 2026, FDA announced that starting October 1, 2026, postmarketing individual case safety reports (ICSRs) for human drug products, biological products, and drug- or biologic-led combination products that are submitted via the Electronic Submissions Gateway Next Generation (ESG NextGen) must be reported using the E2B(R3) data standards ( see 91 FR 17284 ). This announcement extends the previously recommended E2B(R3) implementation period by six months.
rows.review_note: Review: kept the Timelines restatement folded into this row as a true duplicate (same date, gateway and standard) and made it visible in applicability; SRP no-action sentence stays in exceptions. Double-check: quote proves the must, products, gateway and date; 91 FR 17284 cited as basis.

f.title: E2B(R2) ICSRs accepted through September 30, 2026 for companies not yet on E2B(R3)
f.statement: FDA will continue to accept ICSRs prepared in accordance with the E2B(R2) data standards through September 30, 2026, from companies that have not yet transitioned to the E2B(R3) data standards.
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).

rows.actor: Companies with reporting requirements not yet transitioned to E2B(R3)
rows.quote: FDA will continue to accept ICSRs prepared in accordance with the E2B(R2) data standards through September 30, 2026, by companies that have not yet transitioned to use of E2B(R3) data standards.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: level Permitted is a judgement call (FDA acceptance of E2B(R2) read as a permission for submitters); actor inferred.

f.title: Keep all ICSR submissions on E2B(R3) once E2B(R3) submission has begun
f.statement: Once a company with reporting requirements has begun submitting ICSRs in the E2B(R3) data standards format, all its ICSR submissions are expected to use this data standard.
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).

rows.quote: Once a company with reporting requirements has begun submitting ICSRs in the E2B(R3) data standards format, all ICSR submissions are expected to use this data standard.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "are expected to" correctly Recommended; quote proves statement and actor.

f.title: New C.5.4 study type values 4, 5 and 6 accepted by FDA AEMS
f.statement: FDA AEMS now accepts the new values 4 = Patient Support Program, 5 = Market Research Program and 6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform for data element C.5.4 (Study Type Where Reaction(s)/Event(s) Were Observed), in alignment with the ICH E2D(R1) guidance.
f.clause: Alignment with the ICH E2D(R1) Guideline
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Alignment with the E2D(R1) guidance announced March 6, 2026 (91 FR 10619).
f.systems: FDA AEMS; ICH E2B(R3); ICH E2D(R1)

rows.quote: FDA AEMS is now accepting the new values (4 = Patient Support Program, 5 = Market Research Program, 6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform) for data element C.5.4: Study Type Where Reaction(s) / Event(s) Were Observed .
rows.location: Alignment with the ICH E2D(R1) Guideline
data_elements: C.5.4 Study type where reaction(s)/event(s) were observed
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: FDA system acceptance statement read as a permission to use the new C.5.4 values; level and actor are judgement calls.

f.title: Submit postmarketing safety reports in an electronic format FDA can process (2014 final rule)
f.statement: The June 10, 2014 final rule "Postmarketing Safety Reports for Human Drug and Biological Products; Electronic Submission Requirements" requires industry to submit postmarketing safety reports for human drugs and biological products in an electronic format that FDA can process, review and archive.
f.clause: Timelines - Postmarketing Safety Reporting using the E2B data standards
f.legal_basis: Final rule, Postmarketing Safety Reports for Human Drug and Biological Products; Electronic Submission Requirements (June 10, 2014)
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Timelines section; applies to companies submitting ICSRs by database-to-database transmission (E2B).

rows.actor: Industry (applicants and others with postmarketing safety reporting requirements)
rows.quote: On June 10, 2014, FDA issued a final rule Postmarketing Safety Reports for Human Drug and Biological Products; Electronic Submission Requirements, requiring industry to submit postmarketing safety reports for human drugs and biological products in an electronic format that FDA can process, review, and archive.
rows.location: Timelines - Postmarketing Safety Reporting using the E2B data standards
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: page restates the 2014 final rule rather than imposing the duty itself (authority-description row); actor "industry" broad.

f.title: Submit premarketing IND-study ICSRs in E2B(R3) via ESG NextGen from April 1, 2026
f.statement: As of April 1, 2026 (24 months after publication of the final guidance "Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format: IND Safety Reports"), FDA requires electronic submission of premarketing (IND study) ICSRs using the E2B(R3) data standards. The requirement applies to commercial IND sponsors submitting ICSRs electronically to AEMS via ESG NextGen using database-to-database transmission.
f.clause: Timelines - Premarketing Reporting (IND safety reports) using the E2B data standards
f.legal_basis: Guidance for industry, Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format: IND Safety Reports
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Premarketing (IND study) ICSRs; commercial IND sponsors.
f.systems: FDA AEMS; ESG NextGen; ICH E2B(R3)

rows.quote: As of April 1, 2026, (24 months after publication of the final guidance for industry, Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format: IND Safety Reports ) FDA requires electronic submissions of premarketing (IND study) ICSRs in electronic format using the E2B(R3) data standards. The requirement applies to commercial IND sponsors submitting ICSRs electronically to AEMS via ESG NextGen using database-to-database transmission (E2B(R3) data standards.
rows.location: Timelines - Premarketing Reporting (IND safety reports) using the E2B data standards
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "FDA requires" with explicit actor (commercial IND sponsors), date and channel in the quote.

f.title: IND-exempt BA/BE safety reports: E2B submission is voluntary; Form FDA 3500A remains available
f.statement: Electronic submission of ICSRs from IND-exempt bioavailability/bioequivalence (BA/BE) studies is a voluntary option. Submitters may continue to submit IND-exempt BA/BE safety reports on Form FDA-3500A MedWatch (the page names an FDA e-mail destination, which is not reproduced here).
f.clause: Timelines - Premarketing Reporting (IND-exempt BA/BE safety reports)
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Expedited safety reports from IND-exempt BA/BE studies supporting ANDAs.

rows.quote:
The electronic submission of the ICSRs from IND-exempt BA/BE studies is a voluntary option for submission.
 You may continue to submit IND-exempt BA/BE safety reports on Form FDA-3500A MedWatch
rows.location: Timelines - Premarketing Reporting (IND-exempt BA/BE safety reports)

f.title: Submit E2B ICSRs as E2B(R3) XML via ESG NextGen
f.statement: Under Option A (database-to-database transmission), ICSRs should be submitted in XML format using the E2B(R3) data standards via ESG NextGen. FDA posts the E2B(R3) implementation guide, the FDA Regional Implementation Guide and the FDA E2B(R3) core and regional data elements and business rules on the FDA AEMS - E2B(R3) data standards web page to help companies implement the standards.
f.clause: Submitting ICSRs - Option A: Database-to-Database Transmission (E2B)
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).
f.systems: ESG NextGen; ICH E2B(R3); FDA Regional Implementation Guide for E2B(R3); FDA E2B(R3) Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules

rows.quote: ICSRs should be submitted in XML format using the E2B(R3) data standards below via ESG NextGen. These documents are posted on the FDA AEMS - E2B(R3) data standards web page to help companies implement the E2B(R3) data standards for the electronic submission of postmarketing ICSRs:
rows.location: Submitting ICSRs - Option A: Database-to-Database Transmission (E2B)
systems: FDA Regional Implementation Guide for E2B(R3)
FDA E2B(R3) Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: statement narrowed to what the quote says (documents are posted to help implementation, not a separate duty to use them); "should" = Recommended.

f.title: Companies without E2B capability may submit ICSRs via the Safety Reporting Portal
f.statement: Applicants for human drug and biological products, and responsible persons for companies with reporting requirements, who do not have E2B capability may submit premarketing ICSRs, postmarketing ICSRs and respective attachments electronically via the Safety Reporting Portal (SRP) by manually entering the data into a web form.
f.clause: Submitting ICSRs - Option B: Safety Reporting Portal (SRP)
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).

rows.actor: Applicants and responsible persons without E2B capability
rows.quote: Applicants for human drug products, biological products, and responsible persons for companies with reporting requirements who do not have E2B capability may submit premarketing ICSRs, postmarketing ICSRs, and respective attachments electronically via SRP by manually entering the data into a web form.
rows.location: Submitting ICSRs - Option B: Safety Reporting Portal (SRP)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "may" with explicit actor and channel; fully proven by the quote.

f.clause: Submitting ICSRs - Option B: Safety Reporting Portal (SRP)
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).

rows.quote: To submit via SRP, you must first establish an SRP account.

f.title: Gateway partners must not use the SRP for ICSRs
f.statement: A Gateway partner (a company that submits ICSRs electronically via ESG NextGen) cannot use the SRP to submit ICSRs and respective attachments.
f.clause: Submitting ICSRs - Option B: Safety Reporting Portal (SRP)
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).

rows.quote: A Gateway partner (i.e., a company that submits ICSRs electronically via the ESG NextGen) cannot use SRP to submit ICSRs, and respective attachments.

f.statement: To request an SRP account, the submitter should contact FDA (at the e-mail address given on the page, not reproduced here) to advise FDA of its intent to begin submitting via the SRP and to establish an account.

f.title: Begin SRP submissions once the SRP account activation email is received
f.statement: SRP accounts are activated in about 7 to 10 business days from the request, and FDA notifies the requester by email with the subject line "SRP Account Activation", including the portal link and account information. After receiving this email the account is considered active and the company may begin submitting ICSRs via SRP.
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026).

rows.quote:
SRP account activation Your account will be activated in about 7 to 10 business days from the date of request.
 You will be notified via email with the subject line “SRP Account Activation” that will include the Web link to the SRP portal along with your account information.
 After receiving this email, your account will be considered active, and you may begin submitting your ICSR via SRP.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: deadline cleared: the 7 to 10 business days is FDA's activation time, not a submitter time frame (kept in statement); quote carries the "SRP account activation" heading text.

f.title: Submit the PSR descriptive portion in eCTD and indicate that ICSRs were submitted electronically
f.statement: A periodic safety report (PSR) submission comprises a descriptive portion and the non-expedited ICSRs received during the reporting interval (21 CFR 314.80(c)(2) and 600.80(c)(2)). The descriptive portion should be submitted electronically using eCTD specifications and should indicate that the ICSRs have been submitted electronically as XML files to ESG NextGen or via the SRP.
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Postmarketing periodic safety reports.
f.systems: eCTD; ESG NextGen; Safety Reporting Portal

rows.quote:
Please note that a PSR submission is comprised of both a descriptive portion and the non-expedited ICSRs received during the reporting interval of the PSR (see 21 CFR 314.80(c)(2) and 600.80(c)(2)).
 Descriptive Portion: Use Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) specifications to submit electronically.
 Indicate in the descriptive portion that the ICSRs have been submitted electronically as XML files to the ESG NextGen or via the SRP.
rows.review_note: Review: level Recommended -> Mandatory: the page gives direct instructions ('Use ...', 'Indicate ...') with no softening, so they read as directives, not recommendations. Double-check: level Mandatory -> Recommended: imperatives ("Use", "Indicate") on a non-binding web page without "must"; the cited 21 CFR 314.80(c)(2)/600.80(c)(2) supports the PSR composition, not the eCTD/indication instructions.

f.statement: Non-expedited ICSRs must be submitted as described for electronic submission of ICSRs and on or before the PSR due date.
f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Postmarketing periodic safety reports.

f.applicability: FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page (content current as of 09/30/2026). Postmarketing periodic safety reports.

dates.title: FDA AEMS: postmarketing ICSRs via ESG NextGen must use E2B(R3)
dates.scope: Companies submitting postmarketing ICSRs (human drugs, biologics, drug- or biologic-led combination products) via ESG NextGen to AEMS; not SRP submitters
dates.quote: Beginning October 1, 2026, all ICSRs submitted via the ESG NextGen must be submitted to the AEMS database using E2B(R3) data standards.
dates.timing_note: Announced April 6, 2026 (91 FR 17284), extending the previously recommended E2B(R3) implementation period by six months. Submitters via the Safety Reporting Portal need take no action.

dates.title: FDA AEMS: last day E2B(R2) ICSRs are accepted
dates.scope: Companies with reporting requirements that have not yet transitioned to E2B(R3)
dates.quote: FDA will continue to accept ICSRs prepared in accordance with the E2B(R2) data standards through September 30, 2026, by companies that have not yet transitioned to use of E2B(R3) data standards.
dates.timing_note: Once a company has begun submitting in E2B(R3), all its ICSR submissions are expected to use E2B(R3).

dates.title: FDA AEMS: premarketing (IND) ICSRs must be submitted electronically in E2B(R3)
dates.scope: Commercial IND sponsors submitting ICSRs electronically to AEMS via ESG NextGen (database-to-database)
dates.quote: As of April 1, 2026, (24 months after publication of the final guidance for industry, Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format: IND Safety Reports ) FDA requires electronic submissions of premarketing (IND study) ICSRs in electronic format using the E2B(R3) data standards.
dates.timing_note: January 16, 2024 (postmarketing) and April 1, 2024 (premarketing) are the dates FDA began accepting E2B(R3) submissions voluntarily; they are not compliance dates and are not recorded.
